title: Kolokithokeftedes
subtitle: Greek courgette and feta fritters
excerpt: Grated courgette, feta, mint, and dill fried until golden and crisp. Serve them hot as a meze or alongside a simple salad for a light supper.
sourceNotes: Classic Greek meze fritter; feta and mint version is the most widespread across mainland Greece and the islands.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The mixture can be made up to 1 hour ahead and kept chilled. Fry just before serving.

content.text: Kolokithokeftedes are courgette patties held together with egg and flour and fried in olive oil. Squeezing every drop of moisture from the courgette is the one step you cannot skip. Feta provides salt, so taste before adding any extra.

items.prepNote: coarsely grated, salted and squeezed dry

content.text: Grate the courgette into a colander and toss with a pinch of salt. Leave for 10 minutes, then squeeze out the liquid in your hands or a clean tea towel. Squeeze hard.
Tip the dry courgette into a large bowl. Add the feta, eggs, mint, dill, and spring onion. Mix well.
Stir in the flour and pepper. The mixture should hold its shape when pressed into a patty. Add a little more flour if needed.
Chill the mixture for 20 minutes. This helps the fritters hold together during frying.
Heat the oil in the frying pan over a medium heat. Shape heaped tablespoons of the mixture into patties and lower them into the pan.
Fry for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and set. Do not rush the first side or the fritters will break when you turn them.
Drain on kitchen paper and serve hot, with plain yoghurt on the side if you like.

items.symptom: The fritters break apart in the pan.
items.cause: Too much moisture remains in the courgette, or the mixture is too loose.
items.fix: Squeeze the courgette again in a clean cloth and stir in a little more flour. The patty must hold its shape before it goes in the pan.

items.symptom: The fritters are soggy in the middle.
items.cause: The oil was not hot enough, or the pan was overcrowded.
items.fix: Fry in smaller batches. The oil should sizzle immediately when a patty is added.

items.cause: The courgette salt was not rinsed out, or the feta was very salty.
items.fix: Rinse the squeezed courgette briefly under cold water and squeeze dry again before mixing. Taste the raw mixture before chilling.
